description: This file defines a UI component named 'DestinationList' using the Blits framework. It renders a list of destination cards with scrolling capabilities, handling display states such as empty list or populated list, and manages internal scroll mechanics and UI updates.

classes.name: DestinationList
classes.description: A UI component that displays a scrollable list of destination cards, including handling for empty state and custom scrollbar.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for a destination card based on its index.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for a destination card based on its index.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates the scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll state.

methods.name: recomputeScroll
methods.description: Recomputes the scroll boundaries and updates scrollbar accordingly.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles the event when a destination card is selected, logging the selected item's title.
